title: Crash on editor launch (project edit) on linux wayland
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6-stable, 4.6-rc2
- Not reproducible in: 4.6-rc1 4.5-stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Zorin OS 18 18 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (radeonsi, navi21, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.17.0-14-generic) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.43 GiB memory

### Issue description

What's expected:
- After choosing a project from the project manager in Godot, pressing Edit opens the editor.

What happens:
- After choosing a project from the project manager in Godot, pressing Edit causes the entire editor to crash without error.

I have tried opening the Godot editor through the terminal, and this is what appears when the crash happens:

```bash

Inconsistent value (3) for DRI_PRIME. Should be < 2 (GPU devices count). Using: 1
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.3.5 - kisak-mesa PPA - Compatibility - Using Device: AMD - AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (radeonsi, navi21, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.17.0-14-generic)

ERROR: Wayland protocol error 0 on interface wp_viewport@49.
   at: _poll_events_thread (platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:3349)

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 4
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.6.stable.official (89cea143987d564363e15d207438530651d943ac)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues

[4] /opt/godot/Godot() [0x51bade3] (??:0)

[6] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x129c6c) [0x72a243729c6c] (??:0)

```

### Steps to reproduce

- Open Godot
- Choose project in project manager
- Double click the project or press the edit button
- Godot crashes
